stations.title: Ivo
stations.say: I got a page of file paths!

stations.title: The API
stations.text: Errors come back as HTML with a stack trace.

stations.title: Sign-up page
stations.say: Got it, I can show that.

captions: Ivo sent half a body by mistake, and Dilys wants only staff to change workshops.
Today the error comes back as HTML full of file paths, and anyone can delete.
You add a router, a staff check and one error handler that answers in JSON.
Now half a body gets a short JSON 400 the sign-up page can show.
Changes need the staff key, and no error ever shows the server's insides.
